company.name: Cravin Technologies
company.shortDescription: Cravin builds AI-powered, WhatsApp-first commerce tools that help businesses sell, book, and scale effortlessly.
company.description: Cravin is a next-generation SaaS ecosystem redefining how businesses sell, book, and scale through the power of AI, data intelligence, and WhatsApp. Built in the UAE, Cravin unifies commerce into a seamless, app-less experience—where restaurants, sports facilities, retailers, and service providers operate through vertical-specific dashboards, while customers interact through intuitive web apps and the region’s first AI discovery agent, Cravin Concierge (800-CRAVIN). With a commission-free model, real-time insights, and cross-vertical user identity, Cravin is designing the future of social commerce for the MENA region and beyond.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,802,086 to $2,203,610, a 1.22x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
